---
title: "Gallery"
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

```{=html}
<div class="gallery-page">

  <div
    id="gallery-featured"
    class="gallery-featured photo-slot"
    role="button"
    tabindex="0"
    aria-label="Open featured photograph">
  </div>

  <div
    id="gallery-grid"
    class="gallery-square-grid"
    aria-label="Photo gallery">
  </div>

</div>

<div
  id="gallery-modal"
  class="gallery-modal"
  aria-hidden="true"
  role="dialog"
  aria-modal="true">

  <button
    class="gallery-close"
    type="button"
    aria-label="Close">
    ×
  </button>

  <div class="gallery-modal-inner">

    <div
      id="gallery-modal-image"
      class="gallery-modal-image">
    </div>

    <div class="gallery-modal-meta">
      <div
        id="gallery-location"
        class="gallery-location">
      </div>

      <div
        id="gallery-story"
        class="gallery-story">
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

</div>

<script src="gallery.js"></script>
```
